questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: How football clubs make money
Why underdogs can sometimes win and why people love them
The history of the English Premier League and its famous clubs
How to become a sports psychologist
questions.why: They discuss underdog stories and whether being the underdog can actually be an advantage.

questions.q: What does Georgie suggest about being the underdog?
options: It always makes teams lose confidence
It only matters in films, not in sport
Nobody expecting you to win might actually help you
It is better to be the favourite in every single case
questions.why: She says the fact that no-one expects the underdog to win may be an advantage.

questions.q: How does promotion and relegation in English football work, according to Neil?
options: The best three in the lower league go up; the worst three go down
Only one club moves between the two leagues each year
Clubs are chosen by the fans each season
The richest clubs are always promoted, whatever their results are
questions.why: He says the three best clubs in the second league are promoted and the three weakest relegated.

questions.q: What is special about Luton Town FC?
options: It has never been relegated
It is the richest and most successful club in all of England
It won the Premier League in 2016
It rose from non-league football to the Premier League
questions.why: Georgie says they're the first English team to progress from non-league to the Premier League.

questions.q: What does Luton fan Alex think about his team?
options: They don't really deserve to be in the Premier League at all
They will probably be relegated again
They are richer than the other clubs
They have less money, but can compete on the pitch
questions.why: He says they're the underdog financially, “but on the pitch I don't think we will be”.

questions.q: Why do newly promoted teams often start with high confidence, according to Gillian Cook?
options: They have spent a lot of money on new players
Their fans are louder
They have just had a season of winning
They play weaker teams at first
questions.why: She says they've just come from a season of winning, so they believe they can do it.

questions.q: Why does Gillian Cook mention Man City playing Luton Town?
options: To show how pressure to win can make a top team underperform
To predict that Luton will win the league
To show that Man City simply has much better and more expensive players
To explain why Luton fans are angry
questions.why: She uses it to explain “choking”, when pressure gets to a team and they underperform.

questions.q: Who do neutral fans usually support?
options: The team with the most famous players
The underdog
The top dog
The home team
questions.why: Neil says neutral fans tend to support the underdog as well.
